---
title: "Evidence-based Recommendations"
---

## 🎯 From finding → recommendation

<div class="finding"><b>68.4% · Q1</b><br>26/38 reported 2+ hours of mobile use.</div>
<div class="recommendation"><b>Recommendation:</b> Encourage balanced daily screen habits.</div>

<div class="finding"><b>47.4% · Q9</b><br>18/38 used a phone often/every night before sleep.</div>
<div class="recommendation"><b>Recommendation:</b> Promote a screen-free bedtime routine.</div>

<div class="finding"><b>44.7% · Q11</b><br>17/38 reported less than 30 minutes of outdoor activity.</div>
<div class="recommendation"><b>Recommendation:</b> Encourage daily outdoor activity, sports or exercise.</div>

<div class="finding"><b>86.8% · Q13</b><br>33/38 said excessive mobile use affects them sometimes/often/very often.</div>
<div class="recommendation"><b>Recommendation:</b> Conduct digital-well-being awareness sessions.</div>

<div class="finding"><b>97.4% · Q25</b><br>37/38 selected balanced technology + physical activity as the best improvement.</div>
<div class="recommendation"><b>Recommendation:</b> Promote balance rather than complete technology avoidance.</div>

## 🌟 Overall recommendation

**Schools + parents + children** can work together to build a routine that balances:

**Technology + Sleep + Physical Activity + Learning + Family + Values + Life Skills**

<div class="footer-note">
The recommendations above are linked to the collected survey findings. They are awareness recommendations, not medical diagnoses or proof of cause-and-effect.
</div>
